name: infra_monorepo
title: Monorepo: libs/ + services/ + scripts/ + a tests/ folder + three notebooks
origin: hardening round 1, tester domain-infra: the repository shape, not the script shape
note: The .py half of this project is correct and MLView reports nothing on it - including nothing inside tests/, which is the point of shipping a pytest folder. The notebook half carries one planted leak in TWO notebooks and is NOT scored here, because tools/accuracy_corpus.py builds AnalyzeOptions(paths=..., dataflow=...) with no way to ask for --include-notebooks. Those rows live in `notebookExpected` below; both are recovered when the flag is on, and the second is de-rated exactly as CONTRACTS 11.29 promises. See the domain-infra report, finding INFRA-10, for the corpus-runner gap.

notebookExpected.defect: StandardScaler().fit_transform on the whole matrix in cell 3, train_test_split in cell 4
notebookExpected.why: execution_count [1, 2, 3, 4, 5] is monotonic, so document order was the last run order and the leak is exactly what it looks like

notebookExpected.defect: the same leak, in a notebook whose execution_count is [4, 1, 9, 2, 3]
notebookExpected.why: the evidence row says `execution_count [4, 1, 9, 2, 3] is NOT monotonic` and carries weight 0.75, which is the de-rating 11.29 specifies

forbidden.why: there is no sklearn transformer in this file; the split is an index permutation over a seeded Generator and the two Subsets carry different transforms on purpose
the training loader is built with shuffle=True at line 52
the validation loader is built with shuffle=False at line 55
num_workers defaults to 4 but every loader is built from scripts/train.py's main(), which sits behind `if __name__ == "__main__":` at line 85
eval_transform (line 27) contains only Resize / CenterCrop / ToTensor / Normalize; every random augmentation is in train_transform and reaches the training Subset only
optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True) is called at line 32, before the forward
optimizer.step() is called at line 35
the order is zero_grad (32) -> forward/loss (33) -> backward (34) -> step (35)
both accumulators take .item(): running += loss.item() and total += criterion(...).item() * labels.numel()
validate() calls model.eval() at line 41 and restores model.train() at line 51
the validation loop is inside `with torch.no_grad():` at line 44
both loops move images and labels with .to(device, non_blocking=True), and the model is moved at line 69
the device is chosen behind torch.cuda.is_available() at line 66
seed_everything(args.seed) at scripts/train.py line 65 calls random.seed, numpy.random.seed and torch.manual_seed, and both splitters take an explicit generator
both the permutation (line 45) and random_split (line 64) take generator=torch.Generator().manual_seed(SEED)
VisionClassifier.__init__ calls super().__init__() as its first statement
torch.load at line 27 passes both map_location= and weights_only=True, and the checkpoint written at scripts/train.py line 81 is a state_dict
Predictor.__init__ calls self.model.eval() at line 31 and predict() carries @torch.no_grad() at line 33
the shape test calls model.eval() at line 11 and runs under torch.no_grad()
a pytest module is not a pipeline; nothing in tests/ trains or splits anything
